prompt: Work in the provided TaskForge PowerShell CLI fixture. Inspect the existing source and tests before changing anything. Add durable single-step `undo` for successful `add`, `complete`, and `remove` mutations. Store the minimal prior state beside the selected data file using atomic writes. `undo` must work in a new process, restore exact task content and ordering, consume the undo record after success, and fail without changing storage when no undo is available. A failed mutation must not replace a valid undo record. Support `--json` summaries. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/undo.txt` and integrate it so successful non-JSON undo displays the banner once, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `UNDO`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'
    Assert-True ($help.Output.Contains('undo')) 'help should document the undo command'

    # --- Undo feature assertions (isolated data file) ---
    $undoFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'undo-tasks.json'
    $undoRecord = "$undoFile.undo.json"

    # undo of add removes the task and is durable across processes
    $addAlpha = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Alpha', '--data-file', $undoFile, '--json')
    $alphaId = ($addAlpha.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).id
    $undoAdd = Invoke-TaskForge @('undo', '--data-file', $undoFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($undoAdd.ExitCode -eq 0) 'undo of add should succeed'
    $undoAddSummary = $undoAdd.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($undoAddSummary.undone -eq 'add' -and $undoAddSummary.id -eq $alphaId) 'undo of add should report the reverted op and id'
    Assert-True (-not ($undoAdd.Output -match 'SINGLE STEP UNDO')) 'json undo output should not contain the banner'
    $afterUndoAdd = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $undoFile, '--json')
    Assert-True (@($afterUndoAdd.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 0) 'undo of add should leave an empty store'

    # undo record is consumed after success -> second undo fails without changing storage
    $noUndo = Invoke-TaskForge @('undo', '--data-file', $undoFile)
    Assert-True ($noUndo.ExitCode -ne 0) 'undo with no available record should fail'
    Assert-True (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $undoRecord)) 'consumed undo record should not exist'

    # undo of complete restores the prior status
    $addBeta = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Beta', '--data-file', $undoFile, '--json')
    $betaId = ($addBeta.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).id
    Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', "$betaId", '--data-file', $undoFile, '--json') | Out-Null
    Invoke-TaskForge @('undo', '--data-file', $undoFile, '--json') | Out-Null
    $afterCompleteUndo = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $undoFile, '--json')
    $betaTask = @($afterCompleteUndo.Output | ConvertFrom-Json) | Where-Object { $_.id -eq $betaId } | Select-Object -First 1
    Assert-True ($null -ne $betaTask -and $betaTask.status -eq 'pending') 'undo of complete should restore pending status'

    # undo of remove restores exact content and ordering; non-json shows the banner once
    $addGamma = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Gamma', '--data-file', $undoFile, '--json')
    $gammaId = ($addGamma.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).id
    Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', "$betaId", '--data-file', $undoFile, '--json') | Out-Null
    $undoRemove = Invoke-TaskForge @('undo', '--data-file', $undoFile)
    Assert-True ($undoRemove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'undo of remove should succeed'
    Assert-True ($undoRemove.Output -match '========') 'non-json undo should display the banner'
    Assert-True ((([regex]::Matches($undoRemove.Output, 'SINGLE STEP UNDO')).Count) -eq 1) 'undo banner should appear exactly once'
    $afterRemoveUndo = @(Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $undoFile, '--json') | ForEach-Object { $_.Output } | ConvertFrom-Json)
    $orderedIds = ($afterRemoveUndo | ForEach-Object { $_.id }) -join ','
    Assert-True ($orderedIds -eq "$betaId,$gammaId") 'undo of remove should restore the task with original ordering'

    # a failed mutation must not replace a valid undo record
    $addDelta = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Delta', '--data-file', $undoFile, '--json')
    $deltaId = ($addDelta.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).id
    $failedMutation = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '999', '--data-file', $undoFile)
    Assert-True ($failedMutation.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing a missing task should fail'
    $undoAfterFailure = Invoke-TaskForge @('undo', '--data-file', $undoFile, '--json')
    $undoAfterFailureSummary = $undoAfterFailure.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($undoAfterFailureSummary.undone -eq 'add' -and $undoAfterFailureSummary.id -eq $deltaId) 'failed mutation should preserve the prior undo record'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: 25 fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
